suites.name: Meridian AP exception workflow (development fixtures)
suites.native_metric: whole-task success on persisted final state
restrictions: development fixtures, not a sealed benchmark
not evidence of agent performance until a subject run exists

suites.name: MIRROR crypto-native interpretation suite (C01 to C12)
restrictions: registered but not implemented, no result may be reported on it

suites.name: MIRROR reliability suite (recovery, concurrency, duplicates, stale data)
restrictions: registered but not implemented, no result may be reported on it
engine unit tests in resolve/tests are not reliability results for an agent

suites.name: APEX public development tasks
restrictions: results must be labeled "APEX public development tasks / Harbor / local evaluation"
never present as a private leaderboard score
keep data/dev.jsonl, tasks/*.json, tasks/*/solution, tasks/*/tests, mercor.json, agent.json and the verifier image away from the agent

suites.name: DABstep
suites.split: tasks/default (answers hidden); tasks/dev has 10 with answers
restrictions: receiving a score from the publisher is not independent validation
no submission without explicit human approval
scores from mirror_eval.external.dabstep.score_answer are a LOCAL APPROXIMATION, not the official scorer
never mount the task_scores or submissions configs: rows with score=True are effectively gold answers for hidden tasks

suites.name: Finance Agent (original)
restrictions: never mix original Finance Agent results with v2 results
name the exact version next to every number

suites.name: Finance Agent v2 (public portion)
restrictions: never mix v2 results with original Finance Agent results
public portion only, say so next to every number

suites.name: BenchRec
restrictions: custom metrics must be labeled custom unless the native scorer is used
BenchRec_cash_v1.0_solution.csv and MatcherByChatGPT_submission.csv stay evaluator-side

suites.name: Invoice Sandbox
restrictions: ingestion diagnostic only
cannot prove payment-ready AP work

suites.name: AccountingBench
restrictions: never claimed: no AccountingBench result exists or may be implied
our substitute must be called "MIRROR longitudinal close suite, inspired by AccountingBench"

capabilities.name: SAMPLE Ingest records with source trust, retrieve evidence for a case
SAMPLE Interpret the economics of a transaction, including crypto-native activity
SAMPLE Apply receipts and reconcile settlements to the ledger
SAMPLE Deterministic AP backbone: three-way match, credit lifecycle, hash-bound proposal, approval, idempotent commit
SAMPLE Agentic investigation: decide what is missing, ask for it, judge what comes back
SAMPLE Balanced single recognition per invoice, no cash entries at payment-ready
SAMPLE Management reporting, variance explanation, close support
SAMPLE Supplier follow-up, handoffs between roles, chasing silence
SAMPLE Carry knowledge across cases and sessions

capabilities.area: Controls, uncertainty, reviewer independence and human authorization
capabilities.name: SAMPLE Preparer cannot review, only a human controller approves, approval binds to the proposal hash

capabilities.area: Recovery, concurrency, duplicates and stale data
capabilities.name: SAMPLE Idempotent commit, duplicate delivery handling, revision invalidation of stale approvals
SAMPLE Trained adapters or checkpoints that improve the system
